note: Adapted from the species description of Sands (1972); the original is in English and the genus has no soldier caste, only the alate and worker being described; measurement tables, figure numbers, type specimens and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Comparisons with the remaining members of species group I, A. amicus, A. benignus, A. comis and A. concilians, are given in the descriptions of those species; the position of this species within the genus is discussed elsewhere. Whether the abdomen of the worker dehisces is uncertain in this species.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and its pilosity yellow, pilosity very sparse. Postclypeus strongly inflated, Pcl/W 0.35, Pcl/Ri 3.21; apical tooth of mandibles long, La/Li 0.86, Ra/Ri 1.00; accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible separated from the molar prominence in surface view by a distinct notch, compound ratio 17.08; tip of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly posterior to the line from the apical to the second marginal tooth, but its anterior edge as long as that of the second marginal tooth, compound ratio 22.15. Fore tibia moderately inflated, Ti/Ty 3.88, third apical spur pale, about half the length of the other two. Junction of mesenteron and proctodaeum oblique, slightly sinuate, to the right of the Malpighian nodule; enteric valve seating very weakly bilobed, almost a mere rim, connected to the second proctodaeal pouch by a distinct neck, probably lateral in the undissected abdomen; membranous wall of the valve with minute spines outside the inner cushions.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Colour perhaps faded through long preservation of the only known colony. Head capsule yellowish brown, not darkened above the ocelli; fontanelle oval, flat, reduced, slightly paler than the head; mid-spot similar in size and shape to the fontanelle, concolorous with the head; postclypeus pale yellowish brown, labrum yellow; frontal mark an indistinct flat crescent, concolorous with the head; antennae yellow. Pronotum and meso- and metanotum pale yellowish brown, meso- and metanotum without transverse suture; femora yellow, tibiae and tarsi paler. Abdominal tergites and dorsal spiracles pale yellowish brown; sternites and ventral spiracles paler; cerci yellow. Posterior margin of head capsule evenly rounded; ocelli medium-sized, separated from the compound eye by less than two-fifths of their own minimum diameter; postclypeus moderately inflated, Pcl/W 0.30–0.31, Pcl/Ra 2.90, posterior margin evenly rounded, median suture present but not strong. Apical tooth of mandibles rather long, La/Li 0.69–0.79, Ra/Ri 0.85–0.89; accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible separated from the molar prominence in surface view by a distinct notch, compound ratio 11.00–12.60; tip of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly posterior to the line from the apical to the second marginal tooth, but the anterior edges of the marginal teeth of equal length. Pilosity of head capsule yellowish brown, dense and uneven, not felted. Third apical spur of fore tibia only slightly smaller than the other two.
